stack: Next.js websites for owners and walkers
assumptions: Owners and walkers use the same sign-in, with walkers marked as staff.
The walker app is a website that works on phones, not a native app (native is out of scope for v1).

questions.question: Can owners cancel a walk for free, and up to when?

files.name: Home page
files.description: Lists the walkers near you, with their photo and price.

files.name: Booking page
files.description: Shows a walker's free slots and lets the owner pick one and pay.

files.name: My walks page
files.description: The owner's upcoming and past walks, with a cancel button.

files.name: Sign-in page
files.description: Sign in or create an account.

files.name: Walker card
files.description: One walker's photo, name and price, used in lists.

files.name: Server connection
files.description: How the website talks to the server, keeping the owner signed in.

files.name: Today's schedule
files.description: The walker's walks for today, with a button to mark each one done.

files.name: Server start
files.description: Starts the server and plugs in every group of endpoints.

files.name: Walker endpoints
files.description: Lists walkers and their free slots.

files.name: Booking endpoints
files.description: Books, lists and cancels walks.

files.name: Sign-in endpoints
files.description: Signs people in and creates accounts.

files.name: Walker schedule endpoints
files.description: Today's walks for a walker, and marking a walk done.

files.name: Stripe messages
files.description: Confirms a booking when Stripe says the payment went through.

files.name: Staff endpoints
files.description: Removes a walker who has left.

files.name: Card payments
files.description: Charges and refunds cards through Stripe.

files.name: Emails
files.description: Sends booking confirmations and reminders.

files.name: Saved bookings
files.description: Reads and saves walks.

files.name: Saved accounts
files.description: Reads and saves owners and walkers.

files.name: Saved walkers
files.description: Reads and saves walker profiles and their free slots.

files.name: Distance helper
files.description: Works out how far a walker is from an owner.

files.name: Evening reminders
files.description: Every evening, emails owners about tomorrow's walks.

endpoints.name: A walker's free slots
endpoints.description: When a walker is free this week.

endpoints.name: Book a walk
endpoints.description: Holds the slot and starts the card payment.

endpoints.name: Cancel a walk
endpoints.description: Cancels a walk and refunds it if allowed.

endpoints.name: Sign in
endpoints.publicBecause: people have to sign in before they are signed in; 5 wrong tries lock the account for 15 minutes

endpoints.name: Today's walks
endpoints.description: The signed-in walker's walks for today.

endpoints.description: Stripe's message that a card payment succeeded.

endpoints.name: Remove a walker
